name: @cutpro/sdk
description: Cut.Pro API client for Bun, Node, Deno, edge and the browser: Seedance, Wan, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana, Seedream, GPT Image and Gemini TTS with one key, priced per second, image or 1,000 characters
author: Cut.Pro

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace --sourcemap=linked && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
